documents.title: Dose-Response Study of Compound X (SYNTHETIC DEMO MANUSCRIPT)

findings.verdict: The significance claim names no statistical test, no statistic and no degrees of freedom; the reader cannot judge whether the test fits the data.

evidence.quote: A statistical test showed the treatment effect was significant (p = 0.03).

findings.recommendation: Name the test (e.g., paired/unpaired t-test or regression slope test), report the statistic with df and the exact p-value.

findings.verdict: No sample-size justification or power analysis; n=8 is stated without basis, so the significant result may be underpowered/unstable.

evidence.quote: No sample size calculation was performed.

findings.recommendation: Add an a priori sample-size estimate (effect-size source, alpha, power) or explicitly label the study exploratory.

findings.verdict: Reported SD 1.5 does not match the provided data: recomputed sample SD = 1.309307 (n=8, mean 12.0 matches). See stats_check ST1.
findings.recommendation: Correct the SD to 1.31 (or state the estimator/population convention if a different formula was intended).

findings.verdict: Distributional assumptions and independence of the eight samples are never discussed; with n=8 a normality-based test may be fragile.

evidence.quote: A statistical test showed the treatment effect was significant (p = 0.03).

findings.recommendation: State independence/normality checks or use a distribution-free alternative and report it.

findings.verdict: The reported 95% CI upper limit 13.04 is internally consistent with the reported mean/SD/n (recomputed 13.0394 via mean+1.96*sd/sqrt(n)); see ST3. Note it inherits the wrong SD from M3.

evidence.quote: The 95% confidence interval upper limit was 13.04.

findings.recommendation: Keep CI reporting; recompute the interval after fixing the SD.

stats_checks.description: Recompute mean/SD/n of response from data.csv and compare with the manuscript (rel tolerance 5%).
Recompute OLS slope and R2 of response on dose; manuscript reports slope 0.29, R2 0.29 (2-decimal rounding, rel 5%).
Internal consistency: 95% CI upper limit = mean + 1.96*sd/sqrt(n) using the REPORTED mean/SD/n (checks arithmetic, not the SD itself).

evidence.quote: The 95% confidence interval upper limit was 13.04.

stats_checks.description: Attempted recompute of biomarker_x spread; the column is absent from the provided data (honest not_recomputable demo).
